# NexusTek

> NexusTek is your trusted partner in delivering modern IT solutions designed to maximize business outcomes, drive revenue, reduce costs, and mitigate risks for mid-to-enterprise companies.
We specialize in providing IT services that include hybrid cloud hosting, cybersecurity, data and AI, managed IT services, and IT consulting.

## About Us
- [About NexusTek](https://www.nexustek.com/about): Learn about our company, our mission, and what makes us a trusted IT solutions partner.
- [Careers](https://www.nexustek.com/nexustek-careers): Explore career opportunities where innovation thrives and employees can make a significant impact.

## Services
- [Managed IT Services](https://www.nexustek.com/managed-it-services): Transform help desk and infrastructure management with resilient, high-performing managed IT services.
- [NexusOps & NexusIQ](https://www.nexustek.com/nexusops-nexusiq): Experience more consistent, predictable service delivery with faster triage and routing. 
- [Cybersecurity Services](https://www.nexustek.com/cybersecurity-services): Strengthen defenses, reduce risk, and mitigate threats with comprehensive cybersecurity solutions.
- [Managed Detection & Response (MDR)](https://www.nexustek.com/solutions/managed-detection-response): Get 24/7 threat detection, containment, and remediation from an expert security team.
- [AI Email Security](https://www.nexustek.com/ai-email-security-managed-solutions): Stop phishing and reduce risk with proactive, AI-driven email threat detection.
- [CMMC 2.0 Compliance Services](https://www.nexustek.com/cmmc-2-0-compliance-services): Achieve compliance and secure scalable IT environments to protect DoD contracts.
- [Data and AI Services](https://www.nexustek.com/data-and-ai-services): Integrate AI services into your IT infrastructure to transform business operations, increase efficiency, and enhance overall security.
- [IT Consulting Services](https://www.nexustek.com/it-consulting): Design solutions and strategies that directly impact your bottom line with expert IT consulting.
- [Professional Services](https://www.nexustek.com/it-consulting/professional-services): Access world-class capabilities and tailored solutions to elevate your IT strategy.
